authorization: Owner adopted the scaling plan and confirmed 98% / 95% / 90% field precision thresholds. Workflow implementation and local development/calibration are authorized; production silver publication requires calibration approval.
supersedes_hold: New workflow adoption supersedes the implementation hold only. Historical throughput trials stay frozen; no automatic revival of earlier curation/report schedules.
source_scope: Existing screened-pass documents only; new arrivals remain separate.
stop_rule: No uncalibrated silver publication. New arrivals and corpus screening remain paused. Existing data changes require the adopted lane-specific gates.

limited_revision_authorization.scope: User-requested all-material visual and catalogue revision only: molecular viewers, parallel reference cells, source-figure morphology, removal of public review progress, normal experimental-series integration and clear pair counts. Broader curation and recurring reports remain paused.
limited_revision_authorization.source_scope: Use existing displayed figures/captions and curated records; external reference-structure lookup allowed. No new source-paper downloads.
